contract: One Plug adapter for signed plain-text POST /elzoo/v1/messages: fixed source and route, raw-body HMAC-SHA-256 and ±300-second freshness; bounded 65,536-byte body and 15,000-ms returned-read budget; strict six-field JSON event, host-vouched principal with conversation resource grant, and exactly one admission Need call; fixed halted JSON outcomes, with malformed or exceptional admission outcomes unknown and no Run or delivery claim.
limits: The host supplies truthful key, clock, principal and admission Needs, places the Plug before every parser/body reader and enforces the listener's total lifetime.
Plug.Conn has no public universal prior-read flag; parsed/unavailable bodies are refused, but detection of every prior partial read is not claimed.
The monotonic budget is observed only between returned body reads and does not interrupt a blocked adapter call; caller timeouts do not cancel it.
The adapter starts no server or process and does not claim durable admission, Run start/completion, or end-to-end delivery.

grounding.claim: Finite Plug.Conn/Test and controlled-adapter scenarios cover configuration, request framing, body limits and budget, authentication, ordered JSON, scope, once-only admission, normalized outcomes, response bounds and the required negative controls; fixtures are not production authentication or durability evidence.
Pinned Plug.Conn read_body/2 options, one-shot body semantics, returned-connection threading and test adapter behavior.
Pinned constant-time comparison API for equal-length signature binaries.
Pinned ordered-object decoding preserves object pairs for recursive duplicate-key checks.
OTP crypto HMAC-SHA-256 API; a separately computed fixed framing vector is exercised by the Piece test.

The host's key, clock, principal and admission Needs are truthful; the listener supplies the stated route and body lifecycle. A successful admission response is not evidence of Run execution or durable delivery.

telemetry.contract: The Plug emits no logs or telemetry; the host owns request instrumentation.

config.contract: Construction-time options are exactly source_id, key, clock, principal and admit; there is no hot update or persistent configuration state.

control.contract: The adapter owns no process or lifecycle to pause, drain, resume or stop.
